mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which in turn depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent cost pressures.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained HOUST increase, or correlation between HOUST and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals increased economic activity, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM > 1% does not correlate with subsequent returns.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening demand, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS MoM < -1% does not correlate with subsequent returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over a 3-month period signals an accommodative monetary policy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained FEDFUNDS decrease, or correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
